name: Passive Ferrite Bead — Fuse
description: Cluster of 4 tier-B passive ferrite bead and filter parts from Alternate-KiCad-Library mapped to Fuse package footprints for SMD and through-hole mounting.
selection_hints: Match the required footprint such as Fuse_Littelfuse_TSM600, Fuse_SunFuse-6HP, or Fuse_Bourns_TBU-CA.
Select by component configuration including single bead, double bead, double separated, or LCL filter.
Verify whether SMD or through-hole mounting is required.
avoid_when: The PCB design requires a standard ferrite package rather than a Fuse footprint.
A tier A component is strictly required.
The application requires parts from sources other than Alternate-KiCad-Library.
